query: INSERT INTO queue_state (source, version, current_queue_index, progress_secs, shuffle_enabled, radio_cursor, origin) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7) ON CONFLICT(source) DO UPDATE SET version = ?2, current_queue_index = ?3, progress_secs = ?4, shuffle_enabled = ?5, radio_cursor = ?6, origin = ?7
